name: mamba3-scientific-training-plan-v1
principle: Separate base language modeling from instruction SFT. Never continue-pretrain a chat checkpoint directly on raw web shards.

stages.goal: Every sample has metadata and passes license, contamination, toxicity, PII, and dedup gates.
Create deterministic train/valid splits before training.
Train tiny Mamba-3 MIMO-R4 from scratch on governed web/edu data only.
stages.minimum_gate: validation loss must be finite and lower than initial random baseline

stages.goal: Start from base checkpoint, then tune instruction format on instruction-only data.
stages.minimum_gate: eval-english must not collapse into repeated punctuation, digits, or common words

stages.goal: Verify recurrent decode, streaming chat, and warm token/s.

promotion_rule.tiny_to_180m: Only promote after the tiny canary preserves instruction behavior after base-pretrain then SFT.
promotion_rule.180m_to_440m: Only promote on hardware where MIMO-R4 backward passes kernel probe.
promotion_rule.paper_scale: Requires enough storage, long-running orchestration, and a GPU/kernel path that supports MIMO-R4 backward.
